_comment: Settings the scripts read. The assistant fills this in during setup (prompts/01_setup_interview.md); edit it any time. Paths are relative to the workspace. Preferences the assistant reads (stretch share, posting age, weekly targets) live in PROFILE_AND_RULES.md; the numbers below are the ones the scripts enforce, so keep the two in agreement.
_excluded_companies_note: Plain names, or {"name": "Acme", "reason": "why", "until": "YYYY-MM-DD"} for an exclusion that ends. Record the reason and date in PROFILE_AND_RULES.md as well.
_excluded_title_patterns_note: Regexes tested against the TITLE only. A seniority word at the start of a title excludes it; a posting that merely mentions senior colleagues does not.
_lane_title_patterns_note: For feeds (sourcing.py --source github/file): when not empty, a title must match one of these regexes. Leave empty while you are learning what your lanes are.

sources._note: An open, community-maintained feed of new-graduate roles, used as an example. Replace it, or use --source manual, if it does not fit your search.

_watch_filters_note: Overrides for employer_watch.py: lane, off_lane, level, keep_despite_level, remote_pattern (regexes).
